home.app_intro: Two workshops, one goal: pages that need nobody. Compose from scratch with AI, or bring what already exists — either way, the tool makes the result autonomous.
home.cta_login: Already have an account? Sign in
home.f1_desc: Header, hero, pricing, FAQ… every block type has its own specialized generator, trained to produce agency-grade Tailwind. Describe, generate, then iterate by retouching — “make the background light” is enough.
home.f2_desc: Drop a .zip or .tar.gz of any static site — whatever the stack, as long as it's HTML. It becomes editable instantly.
home.f3_desc: Visual editing right inside the page: one click selects, a double-click edits, AI retouches the element without breaking its style. Purists get full-screen Monaco.
home.f4_desc: Attach a domain, point an A record: every “Save” is live within the second. No deployment, no database — the filesystem is the source of truth.
home.home_intro: The modern web chains every page to ten servers you don't own. NADAPROD is the open-source tool that turns every web publication into a self-contained work of art: complete, self-hosted, without a single dependency.
home.marquee: EVERYTHING IS LOCAL. / ZERO EXTERNAL REQUESTS. / NO CONCESSIONS. /
home.network_intro: The code is yours. DWTFYW license — “Do What The Fuck You Want” — MIT-compatible: use it, fork it, sell it, republish it. Below, works already published with the tool.
home.newsletter_more: Detailed application — join the waiting list
home.newsletter_sub: The public instance opens in waves. Leave your email for the next one — or clone the repo and host your own tonight.
home.sendError: Could not send — try again or write to contact@nadaprod.com
home.services_subtitle: Publishing is not enough. On every save, the pipeline rebuilds the published version into a complete artifact: everything it needs to live is inside.
home.svc_log_desc: No tracking cookies, no data collected, no request leaking to a third party. The banner doesn't apologize: it announces “everything stays local”, in the visitor's language.
home.svc_prod_desc: The Tailwind CDN becomes CSS compiled in place. Google Fonts become fonts served by your own site. A service worker makes the work installable and readable offline. You asked for none of it: it's the default.
